posts.name: liarliar
posts.cooked:
So, interesting things about the Prisoner art:

* Legacy's symbol with a bunch of arrows aound it. Not really sure what that means - I'd almost guess it was related to the Iron Legacy story, except that everything else that I can actually pin down leads to Oblivaeon

* Speaking of whom, the Prisoner seems to actually know its name - part of it shows at the bottom of the image.

* "The child is the centre" - the who is what? The only child I can think of would be the Dreamer, and I don't know if we've seen anything about her related to Oblivaeon.

* "It sends its servant" - Progeny.

* "All will end as one," "The future is GONE" - the Oblivaeon event. Again, not much more to say now that we know what's going on there.

* "The guards know" - it's explained in the episode itself that the high-ups in FILTER do indeed know about the end of the multiverse and are cool with it. I assume that's what that is.

Lots of stuff to speculate about!

posts.cooked:
dpt:

"concentric worlds" mean?

con·cen·tric
kənˈsentrik/
adjective
 
  1. of or denoting circles, arcs, or other shapes that share the same center, the larger often completely surrounding the smaller.
     
     
It's referencing the infinite multiverese and how they all share a few particular "Fixed Points" (shared center).

Again I would still question whether it was meant to be humorous or not.

 

Just listened to the episode, I'm in the camp that it was a joke. I did not mind it in this episode (and found it funny) because after the joke they answered some questions that we did not know to ask about Felix (they mention in the show notes they revealed him in this episode so the knew they would not get any questions on him).

In the KNYFE episode, they questioned why we did not ask about the main reality's Paige Huntley and then proceeded to tell us nothing about her. This was less amusing because they acknowledged that we would have questions on something they just revealed but then gave us nothing.
